connect.title: Connect Illustrator panel
connect.intro: An Illustrator panel wants to connect to your account. It will then translate on your behalf, and its jobs will appear under “Documents”.
connect.warning: Only connect if you just clicked “Mit Microsoft anmelden” in Illustrator yourself and exactly this code is shown there. If someone sent you this link: cancel.
connect.doneText: You can go back to Illustrator — the panel will sign in within a few seconds.
connect.expiredText: Please click “Mit Microsoft anmelden” in the panel again.
connect.usedText: This request has already been used by another account.
connect.confirmedOtherText: This request has already been confirmed by another account.

connections.title: Illustrator panel
connections.subtitle: Computers on which your panel is signed in
connections.howto: To connect a panel: in Illustrator, open Window → Extensions → {{org}} Translationtool, click “Mit Microsoft anmelden” and confirm the request here. A connection expires after 180 days without use.
connections.confirmRevoke: Disconnect “{{label}}”? The panel will have to sign in again.
